messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] high-5xx-rate detected on /v1/generate in eu-west-1 starting 22:46 UTC — 15% error rate, spike coincides with rollout tag=feature/weighted-bluegreen-augment
oncall-elena: seeing it, paging in. i'll take initial triage.
 tara-eng: confirming errors in logs. stacktraces look like model variant mismatch: model A expecting ctx schema v2, got v1.
 matt-sre: is this the region-weight change from the deploy? I thought we only flipped weights to 30% new in ap-south and 10% in eu-west.
 kevin-netops: routing table shows eu-west weights were supposed to be 0 -> 10 -> 30; but edge reported a partial weight shuffle — some POPs stuck at 70% new due to stale weight cache. TTL for edge config was 300s, some caches holding old values.
 oncall-elena: immediate mitigation options: 1) flip flag kill-switch for "augment-experiment" (fast) 2) force edge weight to 0 for new variant (requires netops help) 3) rollback deploy (longer). Thoughts?
 sophia-prod: kill-switch first please, customers are seeing hallucinations and malformed json outputs. we need minimal user impact.
 tara-eng: executing kill-switch now: `POST /feature-flags/augment-experiment/kill` — 200 OK.
 incident-bot: Feature flag "augment-experiment" set to OFF by tara-eng at 22:48:14 UTC.
 matt-sre: after kill-switch error rate dropped from 15% -> 7% in eu-west but not to baseline. some subnets still hitting failing variant.
 kevin-netops: pushing force weight update to edge via emergency route control: `edgectl set-weight new-variant 0 --regions eu-west1,eu-west2`
 kevin-netops: edgectl applied, but some POPs report config apply failures (rate-limited API to CDN provider). I'm retrying with backoff.
 oncall-elena: starting customer impact triage: which customers saw errors? ops-rotator please query request-logs for 5xx by customer_id last 30m.
 ops-rotator: top 3 customers by error volume: cust-914 (e-comm), cust-721 (analytics), cust-402 (chat). cust-914 reported user-facing errors and elevated support tickets.
 sophia-prod: emailing cust-914 with heads-up and mitigation status. include incident channel link.
 matt-sre: after second edge push, error rate in eu-west is back to 1.2% — baseline ~0.8% — leaving monitoring on. Rolling windows show lingering DNS resolver caches for some corporate resolvers still sending 10-15% traffic to new variant.
 tara-eng: rationale: rollout used blue/green DNS weight flip + feature flag gating, but the feature flag kill didn't clear connections already routed to the new variant because the gateway held sticky sessions for 5m. also DNS TTL of 300s meant some resolvers kept old weights longer than we expected.
 kevin-netops: mitigation complete: forced weight to 0, cleared CDN caches, and lowered edge config TTL to 30s for next rollout. documenting steps in infra runbook.
 oncall-elena: handoff to matt-sre for monitoring and follow-up. matt please own P1 until we confirm stable.
 matt-sre: taking P1. I'll keep alerts active and coordinate with tara for a postmortem.
 sophia-prod: creating customer incident update note: "We observed a partial deployment mismatch affecting requests from some regions; we disabled the feature and reverted edge routing. There's a chance some customers hit degraded responses during the window 22:46–22:56 UTC. We're investigating root cause and will follow up."
 tara-eng: capturing logs and diffs; looks like deploy agent sent weight update concurrently with config rollout which caused partial state where feature flag and router state were inconsistent.
 matt-sre: timeline so far: 22:46 deploy starts -> 22:47 errors spike -> 22:48 kill-switch toggled -> 22:49 first edge weight push -> 22:51 CDN retry complete -> 22:53 errors down to ~1% -> 22:56 verified stable.
 oncall-elena: adding immediate action items: 1) require coordination barrier between flag flip and edge weight change (assign to tara) 2) reduce TTL for rollout metadata to 30s (assign to kevin) 3) postmortem + RCA (assign to matt) 4) customer follow-up + status page update (assign to sophia).
 kevin-netops: done: lowered edge rollout TTL to 30s in staging, will push to prod tomorrow with canary.
 tara-eng: adding pre-deploy checklist item: "ensure feature flag kill-switch path is tested and that edge weight flip is idempotent if flag toggles mid-rollout".
 matt-sre: assigning postmortem doc to myself. will include timeline, notes, and remediation. target draft by EOD tomorrow.
 sophia-prod: posted incident note to status.redwood.ai and emailed affected customers.
 incident-bot: Incident severity set to P1 by oncall-elena. Incident channel: #incidents. Incident ID INC-2025-315.
 oncall-elena: closing pager for now; handoff complete. if anyone sees residual anomalies ping in this thread. :thumbsup:
